transformations.edit: Extracted the target-local Drain representation from frozen Rust source lines 21-33 into the harness with the source field order preserved, including the `iter: slice::Iter<'a, T>` field used by the target body.
Represented the allocator, Vec, and NonNull storage fields with target-local opaque stand-ins because `as_slice` does not inspect them; the executable target data flow uses only `self.iter`.

Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus method whose body delegates through the Rust source expression `self.iter.as_slice()`; the only target-signature changes are Verus return naming/lifetime and the generated contract's ensures clause.

Instantiated `vec_drain_remaining` as a closed spec relation over `slice::slice_iterator_view(&drain.iter).remaining`, so the target postcondition follows from the delegated iterator-view relation instead of being assumed directly.
